subject: Go-live window rescope and decision log
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@novatrax.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novatrax.com
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Go-live window & evaluation plan

Priya / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Per our conversation, Novatrax is targeting a go-live window the week of 2028-04-04 for an initial pilot (10 seats). Procurement and legal are already engaged but have one internal milestone constraint: budget sign-off is locked to our Q2 board review on 2028-03-29.

Key asks from our side:
- Clear evaluation acceptance criteria so users can run a 2-week trial and sign off by 2028-03-30.
- A mutual action plan (MAP) that ties Redwood deliverables to our procurement steps and legal milestones.

I'll attach our internal calendar and the initial list of success metrics. Can you share a MAP draft and a short decision log format so we can align approvals?

Olivia
Director, Product Ops
Novatrax Systems

Attachment: Novatrax-eval-metrics.xlsx (referenced)

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@novatrax.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement@novatrax.com
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Go-live window & evaluation plan

Thanks Olivia — drafting that now.

Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP with milestones, owners, and target dates). Highlights:
- Target pilot start: 2028-04-04 (2-week pilot)
- Acceptance gate: feature + latency SLAs + sample prompt evals by 2028-03-30
- Redwood deliverables: staging environment by 2028-03-20; onboarding playbook by 2028-03-27

Open questions we flagged in the MAP:
1) Procurement timeline slip risk — do you expect any blocking sign-offs before 3/29?
2) Legal redlines that could affect data residency or logging retention — will Novatrax require Private deployment or is dedicated enough?

I'll loop in Karthik for the eval checklist. If procurement needs a version with specific invoicing terms, mention the contact and we'll include it in the MAP.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Mar 2028 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MAP draft + staging capacity note

Priya — quick note from the CS side after reviewing MAP_v1. A couple of operational constraints to surface as risks:

- Staging GPU capacity: Dedicated staging nodes requested for 4/04 pilot are already provisioned for another customer the week prior. We can reassign but it will add a 3–5 business day provisioning buffer.
- On-call overlap: Our engineering crew has a planned maintenance window 2028-03-24 -> 03-26 that may impact onboarding timelines if we need to push code changes to the staging image.

Risk mitigations (proposed):
- Option A (preferred): Keep pilot start 4/04; Redwood provides containerized image and a short-duration burst of preemptible capacity to cover first 48 hours.
- Option B: Rebaseline pilot start to 4/11 to guarantee dedicated nodes and remove risk of maintenance overlap.

I'll prepare a short risk log excerpt and send it back. We should confirm which option Novatrax prefers so we can lock procurement dependencies.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: risk-log-excerpt.csv (snippet)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@novatrax.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 4 Mar 2028 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Go-live window & evaluation plan — eval gate checklist

Olivia / team —

Attached is an initial evaluation checklist (eval-checklist.md) that maps acceptance criteria to test owners and example prompts. Quick callouts:
- Latency targets are set to p95 < 450ms for standard sessions; we'll need realistic prompt samples from your power users.
- Quality gates: we recommend a sample set of 120 prompts covering transactional and exploratory flows.
- Data handling gate: if Novatrax requires logs to be retained for <30 days or routed to your KMS, that will affect deployment choice.

Please confirm who will be the evaluation leads on your side and whether the legal redlines are expected to change the deployment model.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Attachment: eval-checklist.md

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@novatrax.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novatrax.com, James Lewis <james.lewis@novatrax.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Go-live window & evaluation plan — procurement + legal update

Priya / team — quick update from procurement & legal: 

- Procurement: Budget review moved to 2028-04-05 (board calendar change). This shifts the earliest binding purchase order to 2028-04-06.
- Legal: Attached redlines include two material asks — explicit log retention ceiling (45 days) and a clause requiring data to stay within US regions unless otherwise approved. Legal says these might be accommodated but they could push us toward Private deployment, which affects timing.

Given those changes, Novatrax is requesting a two-week shift to the pilot start (proposed new date 2028-04-18) to align approvals and give time to validate the privacy terms. We understand this impacts Redwood's provisioning planning.

Attachment: novatrax-redlines.pdf

Olivia
Director, Product Ops
Novatrax Systems

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@novatrax.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, procurement@novatrax.com, James Lewis <james.lewis@novatrax.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2028 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Kickoff: Go-live window & evaluation plan — proposed decision log + mitigation

Team —

Thanks for the update, Olivia. Given the procurement shift and the legal redlines, this thread will be our official decision log for the MAP replan. Summary and asks below.

Summary of changes:
- Original pilot start: 2028-04-04
- New requested pilot start: 2028-04-18 (Novatrax request)
- Root causes: Board calendar shift (procurement) + legal redlines raising potential deployment model change

Redwood impact assessment (brief):
- If we keep 4/04: would require burst capacity (Option A) and likely an SLA exception. Risk of degraded onboarding if legal changes are required mid-pilot.
- If we move to 4/18: we can guarantee dedicated staging nodes and align engineering maintenance windows. Preferred from an execution standpoint.

Proposed mitigation path (to lock dates and surface to execs):
1) Move pilot to 2028-04-18; publish updated MAP by EOD 2028-03-08 with new milestones.
2) Redwood provides a non-binding staging reservation for 4/04–4/06 as a contingency (no additional cost guarantee) to allow early smoke tests if Novatrax expediates approvals.
3) Legal/Procurement: Novatrax to confirm whether Private deployment is a hard requirement. If yes, we will trigger an impact assessment and timeline adders in the MAP (target: +2 weeks).
4) Decision/Exec ask: Priya to escalate for a one-time onboarding credit (up to 10% of first invoice) if Novatrax selects Private deployment or requires custom logging retention work. Please confirm approval by 2028-03-09 so we can reflect in the MAP and contract.

Please reply with one of the following by EOD 2028-03-09: 
- APPROVE move to 2028-04-18 and accept the contingency reservation, or
- REQUEST 4/04 pilot and accept the associated execution risks & potential SLA exception.

Quoting Olivia's redline note for clarity:
> "Legal: Attached redlines include two material asks — explicit log retention ceiling (45 days) and a clause requiring data to stay within US regions unless otherwise approved."

I'll send the updated MAP_v1 with the rebaselined dates and an embedded risk-log excerpt tomorrow morning. If anyone from Redwood needs to escalate for credits/exec approval, flag here and I'll route.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--
Priya Natarajan
